proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q hab
  have hN : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    by_cases ha₀ : a = 0
    · have hb₀ : b ≠ 0 := fun hb₀ => hab ⟨ha₀, hb₀⟩
      positivity
    · positivity
  constructor
  · refine ⟨p - a * (a * p + b * q + c) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2), q - b * (a * p + b * q + c) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · field_simp; ring
    · have h : (p - a * (a * p + b * q + c) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - p) ^ 2 + (q - b * (a * p + b * q + c) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - q) ^ 2 = (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [h, Real.sqrt_div (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  · rintro d ⟨x, y, hl, rfl⟩
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hN), ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
    apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
    have hw : a * p + b * q + c = a * (p - x) + b * (q - y) := by linear_combination hl
    rw [hw]
    linarith [sq_nonneg (a * (q - y) - b * (p - x))]
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q : ℝ), ¬(a = 0 ∧ b = 0) → IsLeast {d : ℝ | ∃ x y : ℝ, a * x + b * y + c = 0 ∧ d = Real.sqrt ((x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2)} (|a * p + b * q + c| / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2))
